articles.title: Trump Administration Asks OpenAI to Stagger Release of AI Model
articles.summary: The Trump administration has asked OpenAI to stagger the release of an upcoming powerful artificial intelligence model, according to a person familiar with the matter, nearly two weeks after rival Anthropic PBC suspended its most capable offerings from the market under regulatory pressure.

articles.title: OpenAI Leans Toward Waiting Until 2027 for IPO, NYT Says
articles.summary: OpenAI is leaning toward holding off on an initial public offering until 2027, the New York Times reported, citing three people involved in the company’s deliberations.

articles.title: Chinese physical AI start-up proposes new paradigm that bypasses OpenAI, Meta road maps
articles.summary: A Chinese physical AI start-up has launched a new world model designed to simulate reality by embedding the laws of physics directly into its code – a departure from the data-driven approaches favoured by American tech giants like OpenAI and Meta Platforms. Shanghai-based Fysics AI announced the launch of the Fysiverse, which it described as a “new-generation physics-based world model that adheres to real-world physical laws”, in a post on its WeChat social media account on Wednesday. articles.title: US Stocks Erase Gains as Apple Price Hikes Offset Chips Strength
articles.summary: US stock indexes ended Thursday nearly where they started after a choppy trading session that saw Apple Inc.’s move to raise prices on its products unwinding some of the enthusiasm over strong chipmaker forecasts.

articles.title: China’s cybersecurity industry needs its own Mythos model, 360 founder warns
articles.summary: China must develop its own equivalent to Anthropic’s Mythos model to counter the cybersecurity risks posed by the artificial intelligence era, according to 360 Security Technology founder Zhou Hongyi, who likened the powerful US technology to a “cyber nuclear weapon”. articles.title: Apple to Skip High-End M6 Mac Chips in Favor of AI-Focused M7 Line
articles.summary: Apple Inc. is making one of the biggest-ever changes to its Mac silicon strategy, preparing to jump ahead to a new artificial intelligence-focused chip generation for its next top-end processors.

articles.title: Microsoft Raises Xbox Prices for Third Time in 13 Months
articles.summary: Microsoft Corp. announced a third substantial price increase for the company’s current-generation Xbox video-game consoles in a glaring example of the component shortage crisis that has universally driven up the cost of consumer tech products.

articles.title: Waymo Registers German Entity for Future European Expansion
articles.summary: Waymo is planning to offer its driverless robotaxis in Germany, the latest move by the Alphabet Inc. unit to expand outside the US.
